cases.generated_sql: SELECT `candidate_anchor`.`mktcode`, `candidate_anchor`.`tgtcode`, `candidate_anchor`.`bizdate` FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS candidate_anchor INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT `candidate_left_rows`.`mktcode`, `candidate_left_rows`.`tgtcode` FROM (SELECT `event_rows`.`mktcode`, `event_rows`.`tgtcode`, `event_rows`.`bizdate` FROM (SELECT `q`.`mktcode`, `q`.`tgtcode`, `q`.`bizdate`, `q`.`closePx` / 10000.0 >= MAX(`q`.`closePx` / 10000.0) OVER (PARTITION BY `q`.`mktcode`, `q`.`tgtcode` ORDER BY `q`.`bizdate` ASC ROWS BETWEEN 79 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `event_0` FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q) AS event_rows WHERE `event_rows`.`event_0` = TRUE AND `event_rows`.`bizdate` IN (SELECT `calendar_sessions`.`bizdate` FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS calendar_sessions GROUP BY `calendar_sessions`.`bizdate` ORDER BY `calendar_sessions`.`bizdate` DESC LIMIT 3)) AS candidate_left_rows INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT `candidate_right_rows`.`mktcode`, `candidate_right_rows`.`tgtcode` FROM (SELECT `q`.`mktcode`, `q`.`tgtcode`, `q`.`bizdate` FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q WHERE `q`.`bizdate` = (SELECT MAX(`q_latest`.`bizdate`) FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS q_latest) AND (`q`.`closePx` / 10000.0) < 10) AS candidate_right_rows) AS candidate_keys ON `candidate_anchor`.`mktcode` = `candidate_keys`.`mktcode` AND `candidate_anchor`.`tgtcode` = `candidate_keys`.`tgtcode` WHERE `candidate_anchor`.`bizdate` = (SELECT MAX(`candidate_latest`.`bizdate`) FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` AS candidate_latest)
cases.reference_sql: WITH event_rows AS (SELECT mktcode,tgtcode,bizdate,closePx,MAX(closePx) OVER(PARTITION BY mktcode,tgtcode ORDER BY bizdate ROWS BETWEEN 79 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_high FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic`), recent_events AS (SELECT DISTINCT mktcode,tgtcode FROM event_rows WHERE closePx>=rolling_high AND bizdate IN (SELECT bizdate FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` GROUP BY bizdate ORDER BY bizdate DESC LIMIT 3)) SELECT b.mktcode,b.tgtcode,b.bizdate FROM `newzl`.`hsj_stock_hq_basic` b JOIN recent_events e ON e.mktcode=b.mktcode AND e.tgtcode=b.tgtcode WHERE b.bizdate='2026-04-14' AND b.closePx/10000.0<10
required_sql: ROWS BETWEEN 79 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
